cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json
cases=json.load(open('examples.json'))
print(len(cases))
for c in cases:
    print('====',c['name'])
    print(json.dumps(c.get('raw') if 'raw' in c else c['request'],indent=1)[:4000])
    print('-- response:')
    print(json.dumps(c['response'],indent=1)[:6000])
"
